map.note: src '青青河畔草' (green grass by river-bank) → seat 'grüner Rasen' / 'Am Ufer' (green lawn / at the bank). Direct lexical match: grass-green = Rasen, river-bank = Ufer.
src '鬱鬱園中柳' (dense willows in garden) → seat 'junge Weiden nicken in die Flut' (young willows nod into the flood). Willows = Weiden; 鬱鬱 rendered as 'junge … nicken'.

src '盈盈樓上女' (graceful lady in the tower) → seat 'Das Fenster öffnet sich … allerschönste Frau / Und blickt … Wasser'. Bethge expands into a scene: window opens, finest woman appears and gazes. Three seat lines to one source line (expansion).

src '皎皎當窗牖' (bright/fair at the window) → seat 'Wie ihre Wangen glühn! … Arme / Weiß … schimmern!' (glowing cheeks, white arms). Bethge shifts from posture at window to close physical description; two seat lines.
src '娥娥紅粉妝' (lovely red-powder face/make-up) → seat 'Ja, sie ist herrlich!' (she is splendid). Abbreviated exclamation compresses the cosmetic couplet.

src '纖纖出素手' (slender, slender she puts out her pale hand) — no seat line renders the hand gesture specifically. The motion/hand detail is suppressed by Bethge (whose source was Heilmann/Gautier prose, which also compresses here). Untranslated.

src '昔為倡家女' (formerly a sing-song / entertainer girl) → seat 'Einstmals jubelte / Das Volk ihr zu … Sängerin / Die Herzen … Welt gewann'. Two seat lines expand the former-entertainer identity; '昔' = einstmals, '倡家女' = Sängerin.

src '今為蕩子婦' (now wife of a wandering/dissolute man) → seat 'Nun ist sie eines reichen Mannes Gattin'. Bethge changes '蕩子' (wanderer/rake) to 'reichen Mannes' (rich man) — a semantic shift noted in file header as deformation, but structurally this seat line renders source line 8.

src '蕩子行不歸' (the wandering man goes and does not return) → seat 'Und trauert, daß sie nicht mehr singen darf'. Bethge converts the husband's absence into the wife's prohibition from singing — a substantial deformation, but this seat line occupies the structural slot of source line 9 (husband's situation → wife's constraint).

src '空床難獨守' (hard to keep the empty bed alone) — explicitly flagged absent in the file header: 'Deformation exhibit: 空床難獨守 absent'. The erotic-longing close is replaced entirely by the appended moral (seat lines 13–15). Untranslated.
